outcome: onset of sensory and motor blockade
duration of sensory and motor blockade
cohort: 91 women undergoing elective cesarean delivery at Patna Medical College & Hospital, Bihar
finding: Hyperbaric levobupivacaine provided faster onset of sensory and motor blockade compared to hyperbaric bupivacaine, with similar durations of blockade, but better hemodynamic stability, fewer side effects, and higher maternal satisfaction.
